column3: General  Membership  :  This  includes
members who pay annual membership fees;
Lifetime  Membership  :  This  includes
members who get membership by paying a
certain membership fee as determined by
the body corporate;
Honorary Membership : This includes the
membership awarded by the Chairman and
/ or Executive Board of the body corporate
to  the  members  those  who  are  done
and excellent and outstanding services in
the society so far, or who are deemed to be
able  to  do  such  service  in  the  future,  or
those who have performed in a specific field
or several in accordance wiht the objectives
of the Foundation;
Associate Membership : This includes the
members those who are called for a specific
training  under  the  body  corporate  or
commit themselves to a specific service of
the Foundation during a specific period of
time. This membership is offered upon the
approval of the Chairman and / or Executive
Board and the members are exempted from
the membership fees;
